title: noccaea goesingensis
intro: Noccaea goesingensis, commonly known as alpine penny-cress, is a flowering plant species in the family Brassicaceae. This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, which include its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, and its ability to support cardiovascular health. The therapeutic actions of Noccaea goesingensis are attributed to its bioactive constituents, which include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, among others. Additionally, the plant has been traditionally used to treat various ailments, including fever, rheumatism, and gastrointestinal issues.
